title: GI-Bench: A Panoramic Benchmark Revealing the Knowledge-Experience Dissociation of Multimodal Large Language Models in Gastrointestinal Endoscopy Against Clinical Standards
reasoning: The paper is a medical performance evaluation of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) within the specific domain of gastrointestinal endoscopy. It establishes a clinical benchmark (GI-Bench) to test diagnostic and localization capabilities. There is no component evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics; the ethics mention is strictly limited to the institutional approval of the retrospective study's data usage.
